title: Registry Script Refactor To Vocabulary Discovery Library
description:
This is step M3 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 3.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL, especially the M1 completion note (search "M1 DONE") which lists 5 findings including one **directly relevant to you**: `flow-extension-bim`'s new `Cargo.toml` has a `[package.metadata.semio]` table with no `role` key and doesn't match the registry's current plugin regex, so it's silently missing from the registry catalog — this is a live example of exactly the discovery gap you're fixing.
3. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — M1's new shared vocabulary + discovery library, read in full. This is your new single source of truth.
4. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts` — the CURRENT registry script you are refactoring, read in full including `validateTaxonomyTree`, `validateConstitutionalCrates`, `LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT`, `findNewContractPluginRoots`, and the playground-dedupe logic (`dedupeInFlightPlaygroundEntries`).
5. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/🖥️launch.ts` — the sibling launch.json generator, also read.

YOUR TASK:
- Replace the registry script's 3 ad-hoc path regexes and `LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT` boolean with M1's vocabulary import and `discoverPackages()`/area-maturity model.
- `findNewContractPluginRoots` → `discoverPackages().filter(p => p.role === "plugin")` (or whatever M1's actual API shape is — read discovery.ts's real exported function signatures, don't guess).
- Add a new catalog section fed by the framework-role arm (M1's discovery already returns framework packages; the registry currently has an "unused role='framework' arm" per the plan — wire it up for real).
- Fold `🖥️launch.ts --check` into the main `plugin-registry:check` target (read how launch.ts is currently invoked/wired into project.json to do this correctly).
- Preserve ALL existing behavior for plugins (playground catalog, taxonomy tree validation, constitutional-crate migration tolerance) — this is a refactor of the discovery mechanism underneath, not a change to what gets validated or generated. Verify byte-for-byte (or semantically) identical output before/after for the generated catalog files where nothing should have changed.
- Fix the `flow-extension-bim` discovery gap mentioned above as part of switching to `discoverPackages()` — if the new discovery-based approach naturally picks it up once it has a `role` key, you may need to also fix its Cargo.toml's `[package.metadata.semio]` table to add `role = "extension"` (check with the master doc first whether the W6 flow pilot ticket is closed yet before touching that specific file — if it's still open/in-flight, leave a note in your own ticket instead of touching it, and flag it in your close-out summary for the orchestrator).

VERIFICATION: run `bun 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts generate` then `check` — must be clean, with the SAME set of plugins/playgrounds discovered as before your change (compare counts and, ideally, full catalog diff) plus fixing the fem/flow-bim gaps if applicable. Also run any existing unit tests for the registry script.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, or any plugin directory's OWN files (except the one narrow flow-bim role-key fix above, and only if that ticket is confirmed closed).
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what changed and your verification results, including whether the flow-bim role-key gap was fixed or deferred (and why).
summary:
M3 of the mechanism wave (W4): the plugin registry script now discovers packages through M1's shared vocabulary/discovery library instead of local path regexes and a hand-flipped boolean.

REMOVED → REPLACED BY
- `LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT = true` → `PLUGINS_AREA_STATE`, the plugin area's declared `AreaState` read from `🔣️taxonomy.json` via `areaOf()`.
- `isNewContractPluginManifestPath` regex → `discoverPackages().filter(lang === 🦀️rust && role ∈ {plugin, extension})`.
- the framework-crate regex (`🧰️framework/.*/📦️packages/🦀️rust/(🎯️targets/…)?Cargo.toml`) → `discoverPackages().filter(role === "framework")`, now feeding a real catalog section instead of a dead arm.
- `isModuleCrate` / `isExtensionCrate` / `isPluginBundleCrate` regexes → `findLegacyComponentManifests()`, a structural walk driven by `taxonomy.forbiddenPathSegments` + `ecosystems.🦀️rust.manifestFilename`, gated on the area state. Proven by `🔍️legacy-probe.ts` to select exactly the same 5 sandwich crates the 3 regexes did (zero over-match).
- the hardcoded plugin-SDK path exclusion → dropped (dead: the SDK crate declares no `[package.metadata.component]`, and legacy discovery is now scoped to the plugin area).
- `hasSemioRole()` TOML sniffer → `readSemioMarker()` inside the shared walk.
- the literals `"🎛️apps"`, `"🗿️artifacts"`, `"🎭️modes"`, `"🪟️windows"`, `"📦️packages"`, `"📦️lib.rs"`, `"⚡️implementations"`, `"✏️s"/"🔌️plugins"`, `"📚️examples"` → `TAXONOMY.*` fields, with load-time assertions for the two values the vocabulary has no dedicated key for (`PLUGINS_AREA` ∈ `areas`, `EXAMPLES_DIRNAME` ∈ `rootDataDirNames`) so neither can silently outlive a rename.
- the duplicated file map in `generate` vs `check` → one `renderCatalogFiles()` consumed by both.

NEW FRAMEWORK CATALOG SECTION
`FrameworkPackageEntry` / `generateFrameworkPackageRegistry()` / `emitFrameworkPackagesTypeScript()` emit `🤖️generated/🔣️framework.json` + `🤖️generated/🟦️framework.ts` (`FRAMEWORK_PACKAGES`, 7 rows today: ui-tui/ui-react/ui-wgpu/ui-styling/ui-styling-ts/renderer-react/renderer-wgpu), each with owner path, package path, lang, optional render target, area and derived maturity.

SEVERITY IS NOW DERIVED, NOT HAND-FLIPPED
Taxonomy-tree findings warn while the plugin area is `legacy`/`mixed` and hard-fail once it is `clean`; `validateConstitutionalCrates` and the legacy discovery arm both go silent at `clean`. The W10 finalization flip becomes a one-word edit in `🔣️taxonomy.json` rather than a code change.

LAUNCH GENERATOR FOLDED IN
`🖥️launch.ts` lost its own CLI and became a pure module exporting `generateLaunchJson(repoRoot, playgrounds)` + `LAUNCH_OUTPUT_REL_PATH`; the playground catalog is passed in rather than imported, so there is no runtime import cycle with `📜️script.ts`. `plugin-registry:generate` now also writes `.vscode/launch.json` (after the catalog, so a seed problem can never block catalog output) and `plugin-registry:check` byte-compares it, with a seed/devLaunchers mismatch surfacing as a violation instead of an unhandled throw. Launch freshness is therefore enforced by the same target the root `verify gate` already calls — no project.json/nx or seed change was needed.

VERIFICATION
- Before/after catalog diff against a pre-refactor copy of the script (`🧪️catalog-diff.ts`): 0 field mismatches across all 34 shared plugin rows and all 58 playground rows.
- `generate` → 37 plugin crates, 58 playgrounds, 7 framework packages; `check` → green (only the pre-existing warn-only 🏗️fem `📡️protocol` finding).
- `.vscode/launch.json` regenerated byte-identical (`git diff --stat` empty).
- `tsc --noEmit` on both files: no new errors (3 pre-existing — `import.meta.dir` plus 2 in repo-lib).
- repo-lib suite 121 pass / 9 fail — exactly M1's recorded baseline; all 20 taxonomy+discovery tests pass. No test file exists for `@semio-tech/plugin-registry`, so there was none to extend.

LIVE DISCOVERY GAP FIXED (unplanned, caught by the diff harness)
Mid-ticket, the concurrent `SOURCING-PLUGIN-EXTENSIONS-DE-SANDWICH` agent moved 🪵️sourcing's three extension crates to `📦️packages/🦀️rust` with `role = "extension"`, and the old regexes dropped `sourcing-module-beams`, `sourcing-module-slabs` and `sourcing-module-windows` from the catalog the instant those dirs moved (37 → 34 rows). This is a second live instance of the plan's predicted "Step 3 silently drops plugins from the runtime loader" risk, beyond the flow-bim one M1 flagged. The refactored discovery recovers all three with identical pluginId/packageName/wasmOut/contributes/consumes.

LIVE DISCOVERY GAP DEFERRED
`flow-extension-bim` is still missing: `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/🧩️extensions/🏗️bim/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml` has a `[package.metadata.semio]` table with no `role` key. NOT touched, because ticket `26/08/06/FLOW-PLUGIN-TS-MODULES-AND-EXTENSIONS-CONSOLIDATION` is still open and claims exclusive ownership of `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/🧩️extensions/*` (the sibling `FLOW-PLUGIN-RESIDUAL-MOP-UP-…` ticket is closed but does not own that file). Once it closes, adding `role = "extension"` to that table plus a `registry:generate` re-run should take the catalog to 38 rows. The same file also still carries its `⚠️ TEMPORARY VERIFICATION OVERLAY` `[workspace]` block, which must be removed before root `cargo metadata` can resolve the crate — registrar duty, also not touched. Both are written up in the ticket's `📋️notes.md`.

Constraints honoured: no root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs or plugin-directory files touched; no git-modifying commands; no worktrees; no backgrounded Bash; all scratch files live in the ticket folder.
